analysis.executive_summary: Vercel's documentation spans 6,845 crawled pages with strong retrieval readiness (88.38 overall score, 97.88% answerability). Critical gaps include 43 confirmed broken internal links across user-facing docs, API reference coverage at only 15.0% despite 1,119 API pages detected, and last-updated metadata visible on just 47.66% of pages. Example code reliability stands at 81.69%, and 53.14% of content carries stale risk due to missing freshness signals. Evidence coverage is solid at 86.46% (11,518 of 13,321 claims backed), but low API coverage and broken links directly undermine user trust and AI answer quality.
strengths: High answerability (97.88%) and chunkability (92.26%) support strong LLM retrieval and user comprehension
86.46% of key claims include supporting evidence, reducing ambiguity and increasing trust
100% citationability ensures all content can be properly attributed in AI-generated answers
Example code reliability at 81.69% indicates majority of samples are functional
Comprehensive crawl coverage (100.01% of scope, 6,845 pages) with high confidence (89.72% overall)
risks: 43 broken internal links in user-facing docs degrade navigation, SEO, and user confidence
API reference coverage at 15.0% leaves 85% of 1,119 API pages without usage examples or integration guidance
53.14% stale risk due to missing last-updated dates prevents users from assessing content currency
Only 47.66% of pages display last-updated metadata, obscuring freshness for half the documentation
18.31% of examples may be unreliable or outdated, risking failed onboarding and support escalations
2 links unverified due to auth/rate-limit blocks may hide additional broken references
Low API coverage undermines developer onboarding velocity and increases support ticket volume for integration questions
